title: say in the reviewer brief that shell variables are denied, so reviewers use literal absolute paths

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-015049-981c, project ork, item S494:

say in the reviewer brief that shell variables are denied, so reviewers use literal absolute paths

Evidence: Bash with W=... was denied "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs" (already filed as S479/S481)
